column1: # Divergence registry: deliberate differences from MuJoCo 3.5.0, each with the test that shows it. Every
# `divergence=<ID>` note in verdicts.tsv names an ID here (mujoco_conformance/layer_e_census.rs checks it);
# a row no note names is a difference no census doc exercises.
# kind: stricter (we refuse what MuJoCo accepts) · limitation (MuJoCo does what we cannot) ·
#       no-effect (accepted, with no effect) · lenient (we load where MuJoCo wrongly refuses) ·
#       wrong-value (MuJoCo computes a wrong value; the test shows ours is right) ·
#       extension (a quantity MuJoCo does not have).

column3: loads NaN and inf in keyframe and tendon springlength values
steps at a timestep of zero (time stands still), a negative one (time runs backwards) and a non-finite one (time becomes NaN or inf, qpos NaN, with a bad-qpos warning)
column4: refuses a timestep that is not positive and finite in step, step1, step2, forward and forward_skip, before any work (StepError::InvalidTimestep)

column3: steps an mjData made by another model unchecked (it stores the model signature and never reads it)
column4: refuses a Data made by a model of other dimensions (StepError::DataShapeMismatch)

column3: resets mjData and skips the copy for a keyframe index outside 0..nkey (mj_resetDataKeyframe)
column4: refuses the index (ResetError::InvalidKeyframeIndex) and leaves Data unchanged

column3: has no drift baseline (mjData has energy[2] only)
column4: Data::energy_initial: the total energy at the first forward pass that computes energy after make_data or a reset
a cloned Data (and a finite-difference scratch copy) has no plugin_data: there is no copy hook

column3: refuses a ball joint followed by a ball or hinge on its body, and does not check that a limited range's bounds are finite
column4: Model::try_make_data also refuses a ball followed by a slide, and a limited joint, tendon or activation range with an infinite bound (MakeDataError)
